thread:
michael: Heads-up: rolling out On-Prem Agent v2.1.0 next Tue (3/31). Primary callouts: KMS rotation support, packaged compliance attestations (audit-ready artifacts), and a telemetry opt-out window. No expected customer-facing downtime for standard installs, but the agent will restart. See checklist below.

michael: Quick checklist (paste into customer threads):
- Confirm KMS access + key policy
- Run preflight script: `./agent preflight --env prod`
- Schedule maintenance window if using pinned models
- If air-gapped, follow offline bundle steps in the runbook

ada: Thanks — are the attestation artifacts per-customer or a generic bundle?

eva: Also pinging SEs: any customers in pilot that need an extended rollback plan? @ada

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout job created: onprem-agent-v2.1.0 -> staging -> canary -> prod. Estimated canary: 3/31 14:00 UTC. Link: https://ci.internal/release/789

compliance: Artifacts are per-deployment: we generate an attest.json with SHA256 fingerprints and a concise control-mapping.csv. We'll surface those to the tenant bucket (S3 path) and include checksum + signed timestamp.

ada: Got it, per-tenant sounds good. Is the KMS rotation automated or manual for now?

michael: Rotation is opt-in. We added a new operator flag `--auto-rotate-kms` but default is off. For customers that opt in, rotation occurs during low-traffic windows and the agent performs a staged key swap with 1-min overlap.

sam: Migration scripts — any DB schema changes to the agent local state? I want to bundle the update with the config-migration helper.

michael: No schema changes. We added a migration helper but it's idempotent; command: `./agent migrate-config --from v2.0 --to v2.1` (safe to run twice). We'll post the helper in the release notes.

cto_jen: Great work. Compliance team, please coordinate with customer success for the first 5 pilots. If anything looks flaky, we pause.

compliance: Will do. We'll also attach an evidence pack for legal review on request.

ada: One more: telemetry opt-out window — what's the default retention policy for logs/metrics? Need a short blurb for customer comms.

michael: Default: 30 days for metrics, 7 days for debug logs in default install. Telemetry opt-out prevents exporting metrics off-host; customers can keep local metrics and request full opt-out for air-gapped deployments. Add to comms: "We collect minimal runtime metrics to maintain service health; customers can opt out during installation or via the console."

eva: Noted. I'll update the SE playbook and ship the patch notes. Can we get the final release notes by EOD Fri?

michael: Yes — aiming for EOD Fri. I'll drop the release notes + migration checklist here when ready. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window for pilot customers: 2026-03-31T14:00:00Z -> 2026-03-31T16:00:00Z (subject to change).
